atlas_name: Rare Disease Venture & Translational Opportunity Atlas

contribution_protocol.zero_pii_policy: Submissions must contain zero patient-identifiable data, zero personal email addresses, zero local filesystem paths, and zero API secrets.
contribution_protocol.citation_standard: Every biological or clinical claim must cite verified accessions formatted as NCT########, PMID:########, GEO:GSE######, PDB:XXXX, or ORPHA:####.

open_problems.title: Mutant-Selective JAK2 V617F JH2 Allosteric PROTAC / Molecular Glue Ternary Complex Design
open_problems.biological_hypothesis: All four approved MF JAK inhibitors bind the conserved JH1 ATP hinge (Glu930/Leu932), inhibiting wild-type JAK2 EPOR/MPL signaling and causing dose-limiting anemia/thrombocytopenia while permitting Type I heterodimer persistence. Anchoring a CRBN/VHL heterobifunctional degrader in the V617F-rearranged JH2 pseudokinase pocket (Phe617-Phe595-Phe537 triad) can exploit ternary cooperativity (alpha > 1.5) to catalytically eliminate full-length mutant JAK2 V617F while sparing wild-type JAK2.
evaluation_criteria: Predicted binary + ternary selectivity >=50x for JAK2 JH2(V617F) over wild-type JAK2 JH2 (PDB:4FVP) and >=100x over catalytic JH1 (PDB:3KRR) via FEP/alchemical free-energy or bolted conformational ensembles.
Positive predicted ternary-complex cooperativity (alpha > 1.5) and productive lysine ubiquitination geometry with human CRBN or VHL without steric clash on EPOR/MPL dimers.
Physicochemical & oral/parenteral developability audit (synthetic accessibility score, linker rigidity, efflux liability) plus CRO assay protocol (<$150K) in isogenic Ba/F3-EPOR V617F vs WT cells.
expected_deliverables: Ranked SDF/SMILES library (top 20 warhead-linker-E3 chimeras) with 3D docked ternary coordinates.
Quantitative selectivity table (ddG_bind V617F vs WT JH2 and JH1 counter-screen).
Outsourced DiscoverX TR-FRET + HiBiT degradation experimental validation plan.

open_problems.title: Subtractive Single-Cell Fibrosis-Reversal Target Discovery: Reversible AIMF vs Persistent Clonal PMF
open_problems.biological_hypothesis: Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF) achieves 74-80% complete hematologic response and physical marrow reticulin resolution within 3-12 months of steroid/rituximab immunosuppression ('Nature's Positive Control'), whereas clonal JAK2 V617F+ PMF maintains S100A8/A9-TLR4-GLI1+ myofibroblast collagen deposition even under JAK inhibition. Isolating the transcriptional and MMP/LOXL2 matrix-remodeling switches separating resolving inflammation-driven reticulin from cross-linked clonal fibrosis unlocks non-myelosuppressive 505(b)(2) antifibrotic combinations.
evaluation_criteria: Differential ligand-receptor network reconstruction (megakaryocyte/lymphoid -> LepR+/GLI1+ MSC) contrasting clonal GATA1-low megakaryocyte circuits (TGFB1, CXCL4, S100A8/A9) against polyclonal CD8+/Th1/B-cell autoimmune circuits (IFNG, IL6, TNF).
Identification of druggable stromal de-differentiation & ECM-clearance regulators (e.g., LOXL2 cross-linking vs MMP remodeling) with zero predicted EPOR/MPL hematotoxicity.
Top 10 clinical-stage or FDA-approved 505(b)(2) repurposing candidates cross-scored for human bone-marrow exposure and platelet/hemoglobin safety.
expected_deliverables: Reproducible single-cell ligand-receptor & gene-regulatory network scoring matrix.
Ranked 505(b)(2) compound dossier with human PK marrow-exposure margins and IP/Orphan Drug exclusivity strategy.
Primary human MF CD34+ + LepR+ stromal 3D co-culture validation design.

open_problems.title: Zero-Misrouting Multimodal Triage Separating Curable AIMF and VEXAS from Clonal Triple-Negative PMF
open_problems.biological_hypothesis: 30-40% community diagnostic discordance in JAK2/CALR/MPL-negative 'dry tap' marrow fibrosis exposes curable AIMF patients to futile $200K/yr cytopenic JAK inhibitors or lethal allo-HSCT conditioning, while leaving somatic UBA1 VEXAS patients undiagnosed for 4-7 years. Transparent fusion of WSI megakaryocyte/lymphoid topology, HMR + UBA1 genomics, serology, and iron kinetics can prevent misrouting.
evaluation_criteria: >=95% sensitivity for reversible AIMF and somatic UBA1 VEXAS prior to any allo-HSCT or JAK inhibitor order.

Strict 21st Century Cures Act Sec. 3060(a) transparency: every diagnostic recommendation exposes clinician-verifiable morphologic, serologic (ANA, DAT), MCV/vacuole, and clonal NGS (ASXL1, SRSF2, U2AF1, EZH2, UBA1) rules.
Explicit triage of iMCD-TAFRO (ORPHA:93685) in acute thrombocytopenic/anasarca ICU presentations.
expected_deliverables: Open-source FHIR/JSON clinical rule specification + WSI morphometric feature schema (megakaryocyte cluster index vs CD8+/CD20+ lymphoid aggregate index).
Calibration & decision-curve analysis quantifying prevented inappropriate HSCT/JAKi outlays.
Clinician-facing 1-page differential reflex testing report template.

open_problems.title: FDA RDEA Composite Disease-Modification Endpoint Resolving Phase 3 SVR35 / TSS50 Discordance
open_problems.biological_hypothesis: Frontline Phase 3 MF combinations (MANIFEST-2 pelabresib NCT04603495, TRANSFORM-1 navitoclax NCT04472598) doubled Week-24 SVR35 yet missed dichotomous TSS50 diary cutoffs due to ruxolitinib JAK1 symptom saturation, while multi-year salvage OS trials (IMpactMF NCT04576156) face high attrition and crossover latency. A continuous composite surrogate integrating WSI reticulin morphometry, driver/HMR VAF slope, and transfusion-free survival can de-risk registrational Phase 2/3 trials.
evaluation_criteria: Statistical power simulation demonstrating reduced false-negative error vs binary Week-24 TSS50 while maintaining strict Type I error control under realistic drug-induced GI/cytopenia symptom noise.
Quantitative weighting of continuous WSI reticulin/collagen reduction, peripheral JAK2/CALR/HMR VAF clearance, hemoglobin/transfusion independence, and Absolute-TSS.
Alignment with FDA Rare Disease Endpoint Advancement (RDEA) qualification evidentiary standards.
expected_deliverables: Open Python/R trial-simulation benchmark reproducing historical Phase 3 SVR35/TSS50/OS operating characteristics.
Composite endpoint mathematical specification and minimum clinically important difference (MCID) justification.
Draft FDA RDEA briefing outline anchored on MPN PROGRESSion Registry (NCT07362225) real-world longitudinal validation.

open_problems.title: Dual-Compartment Iron-Hepcidin & Marrow Stromal Ferroptosis Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Model
open_problems.biological_hypothesis: Anemic MF and AIMF patients frequently co-express two opposing iron pathologies: (1) IL-6/BMP6/ACVR1 -> HAMP (hepcidin) degradation of macrophage SLC40A1 (ferroportin) causing iron-restricted erythropoiesis, and (2) chronic PRBC transfusional hemosiderosis saturating transferrin (TSAT >75%) to generate toxic NTBI/LPI that depletes stromal GPX4 and amplifies TGFB1/S100A8/A9 fibrosis. Precision therapy requires separating ACVR1-inhibitor responders from deferasirox-chelation candidates while blocking PV hepcidin mimetics (rusfertide).
evaluation_criteria: Mechanistic multi-compartment ODE/PK-PD model coupling hepatic IL-6/STAT3 + BMP6/ACVR1 -> HAMP synthesis, macrophage SLC40A1 flux, PRBC iron input, plasma TSAT/NTBI/LPI threshold kinetics, and erythroid hemoglobin output.
Accurate reproduction of momelotinib (MOMENTUM NCT04173494) hepcidin suppression & hemoglobin recovery vs deterministic safety block against rusfertide (NCT05210790) in anemic MF.
Actionable clinical biomarker boundary separating pure macrophage iron trapping from mixed/parenchymal hemosiderosis post-AIMF remission.
expected_deliverables: Self-contained Python ODE simulation script + parameter sensitivity table.
Phase-plane diagnostic nomogram mapping (TSAT, Ferritin, CRP/IL-6, PRBC units) to optimal therapeutic class (ACVR1i vs immunosuppression vs deferasirox chelation).
Validation test suite passing MyelofibrosisBench-v1 Category 2 (iron_hepcidin_axis).

open_problems.title: Non-Myelosuppressive Clonal Persistence-Breaking Combination Design (Type II JAK2 / JH2 / PIM1 / MDM2)
open_problems.biological_hypothesis: Median survival after ruxolitinib discontinuation is 11-23 months because Type I JAK2 inhibition preserves Y1007/Y1008-hyperphosphorylated JAK2/JAK1 heterodimers and STAT5-driven PIM1/BCL2L1/MCL1 survival loops, whereas BCL-XL blockade causes dose-limiting platelet apoptosis. Rational pairing of WT-sparing JH2 (INCB160058) or Type II DFG-out (AJ1-11095) agents with non-cytopenic PIM1 (nuvisertib) or zero-washout MDM2 (navtemadlin) mechanisms can deepen VAF clearance without Grade 4 cytopenias.
evaluation_criteria: Signaling-network synergy & hematologic toxicity index modeling megakaryocyte/platelet viability (BCL2L1 preservation) alongside mutant CD34+ VAF depletion.
Explicit genomic exclusion/stratification rules preventing positive selection of pre-existing TP53-mutant subclones (GEO:GSE226340) under MDM2 inhibition.
Zero-washout adaptive Phase 1b/2 clinical trial protocol with sequenced non-dilutive funding plan (MPNRF + NCI SBIR + Blood Cancer United TAP).
expected_deliverables: Quantitative pathway synergy & cytopenia-window scoring table across 6 candidate doublet regimens.
Genotype-stratified trial schema (JAK2 V617F vs CALRmut vs HMR vs TP53-WT/mut).
90-day CRO primary MF CD34+ colony/VAF killer-experiment budget and grant stack.
